methodologyNotes: Covers complete electronic drum kits sold as a bundle (sound module plus pads, rack, and mounting hardware) at a published US MSRP or typical street price. Excludes standalone modules/brains sold without pads, drum-trigger add-on packs for acoustic kits, tabletop/all-in-one percussion pads, and toy kits. Price is US MSRP or typical street price in USD for the standard bundle configuration. soundModule is the manufacturer model designation of the included brain (string; null if an unbranded/generic module). presetKits is the count of factory preset drum kits. voiceCount is the number of onboard instrument sounds/voices. drumPadCount is the number of drum pads (snare + toms + kick trigger/pad). cymbalPadCount is the number of cymbal pads (hi-hat + crashes + ride). snarePadType is an enum: mesh, rubber, or silicone. allMeshHeads is a boolean, true only if every snare and tom pad uses a mesh head. snareSizeIn is the snare pad head diameter in inches. hiHatType is an enum: separate-stand (hi-hat pad mounts on a real hi-hat stand with a controller) or pad-mounted (fixed hi-hat pad on the rack). bluetooth is a boolean, true if Bluetooth audio and/or MIDI is supported. usbMidi is a boolean, true if USB-MIDI (and/or USB audio) connectivity is present. weightKg is the total kit weight (rack, pads, and module) in kilograms; null if not disclosed.

products.name: Roland TD-17KVX2
products.priceNote: US street price $2,089.99, listed verbatim at Percussion Source (percussionsource.com; "Model Number TD-17KVX2", price "$2,089.99") and independently at Mundt Music (mundtmusic.com; "Price: $2,089.99", Manufacturer Part # TD17KVX2). Roland's own US page marks the kit "Discontinued" and shows no price.
products.provenance: The Roland US specifications page confirmed the exact model TD-17KVX2 via its kit configuration (TD-17 sound module, PDX-12 12-inch mesh snare, three PDX-8 mesh toms, VH-10 hi-hat that mounts on an acoustic stand, two CY-12C-T crashes, CY-14R-T ride, KD-10 kick, MDS-Compact stand), "70 premium preset drum kits", Bluetooth audio streaming, and total weight "24.7 kg"; it lists the product as Discontinued with no price. Percussion Source (West Music) explicitly lists "Model Number TD-17KVX2" at "$2,089.99" and corroborates the five-piece configuration, 12-inch PDX-12 snare, and three 10-inch PDX-8 toms; Mundt Music independently shows the same "$2,089.99" for the same model. Because Roland publishes no price, the price is taken verbatim from these two US retailers. voiceCount and usbMidi were not explicitly stated on any fetched page and are left null.

Voice count (728 internal sounds) was confirmed on the MusicStore USD listing and the 2022 release year on the Edrumcenter listing (both real fetched pages, but not the cited source/corroboration URLs).

products.name: Alesis Strata Prime
products.priceNote: US$3,499.00 listed at Guitar Center (Item #1500000419223, US authorized dealer) and identically at Kraft Music ($3,499.00, US authorized dealer); used as the US typical street price. (Thomann EU lists US$2,699, i.e. the European market price, so the US figure $3,499.00 was used.)
products.provenance: The official Alesis product page confirms this is the flagship Strata Prime (10-piece all-mesh kit with the Prime Drum Module and 10.1" touchscreen), distinct from the cheaper Strata Core (7" display, ~$1,666) and Strata Club (~$1,479). Guitar Center (US authorized dealer, MPN STRATAPRIME) lists it at $3,499.00 and provides the full verbatim spec table: 75 factory drum kits, 440+ kit pieces, dual-zone 14" mesh snare, 8"/10"/12"/14" mesh toms, 20" mesh kick, two 16" crash + one 18" ride triple-zone cymbals, a 14" magnetic stand-mounted hi-hat (stand sold separately), and Module MIDI I/O of "USB MIDI, 5-pin In/Out, Bluetooth MIDI." Kraft Music (US authorized dealer) independently corroborates the identical $3,499.00 price and the all-mesh "six drums" configuration, and Thomann lists availability since March 2024; total kit weight is disclosed only in pounds (95.2 lbs), so weightKg is left null to preserve verbatim sourcing.

products.name: Alesis Nitro Max
products.priceNote: US price $399 per the fetched Thomann product page ("$ 399"; "This item exactly $399"). No manufacturer MSRP figure appeared on the fetched official Alesis support page, so the $399 retailer figure is used verbatim.
products.provenance: The official Alesis support FAQ (support.alesis.com) confirmed this is the exact "Alesis Nitro Max Kit" and listed its included components verbatim: a 10" dual-zone mesh snare pad, three 8" mesh tom pads, 10" hi-hat/crash(w/choke)/ride pads, a kick pad tower, a 4-post aluminum rack, plus new Bluetooth audio streaming and a class-compliant USB/MIDI connection and a continuous-variable hi-hat pedal. The Thomann retailer page (dated, "Available since October 2023") corroborated the same exact model and stated the module's 440 drum/cymbal/percussion sounds, 32 BFD preset drum kits plus 16 user kits, all-mesh pads ("Mesh Head Pads: Yes"), Bluetooth, USB/MIDI, and the US price of $399. Weight was only described as "less than 15kg" (no precise figure disclosed), so weightKg is left null.

products.name: Yamaha DTX6K3-X
products.priceNote: US MSRP $2,043.52 per Percussion Source ("MSRP Regular Price $2,043.52"). Independently corroborated by Chuck Levin's Washington Music Center, which lists "MSRP: $2043 00". Yamaha's official spec page does not publish a price.
products.provenance: The Yamaha USA spec page lists four DTX6 kits in column order (DTX6K5-M, DTX6K3-X, DTX6K2-X, DTX6K-X); the DTX6K3-X column shows an 8-inch TCS 3-zone snare, 7-inch TCS tom and floor-tom pads, an RHH135 13-inch 2-zone hi-hat on an HS650A hi-hat stand, PCY135 13-inch 3-zone crash 1, crash 2 and ride, "Preset: 40 Kits, User: 200 Kits", "Voices 712", "USB TO DEVICE, USB TO HOST" (no Bluetooth in the connector list), and Weight "36.6 kg" — the basis for every spec value. Percussion Source (page title "Yamaha DTX6K3-X", "Model Number DTX6K3") confirms the DTX-PRO sound module, TCS (Textured Cellular Silicone) pads, USB audio and MIDI, and "MSRP Regular Price $2,043.52". Chuck Levin's independently corroborates the exact model, the 8-inch TCS snare, 712 voices, 40 preset kits, the HS650A hi-hat stand "included with the DTX6K2-X and the DTX6K3-X", and MSRP ~$2,043 — confirming this is the DTX6K3-X and not the mesh DTX6K5-M or rubber-tom DTX6K2-X/DTX6K-X.

products.name: Yamaha DTX10K-X
products.priceNote: US street price of $5,169.99 for the DTX10K-X (Real Wood) as listed by retailer Kraft Music (kraftmusic.com). The Yamaha USA spec page does not publish an official MSRP; this is a typical retail street price. Same price applies to the Black Forest finish (identical bundle).
products.provenance: The Yamaha USA DTX10 Series specs page has a dedicated DTX10K-X column confirming this exact model: XP125SD-X 12-inch TCS snare, XP105T-X 10-inch TCS toms and XP125T-X 12-inch TCS floor tom (TCS = textured cellular silicone, NOT the mesh heads of the sibling DTX10K-M), KP128 kick, four cymbal pads (RHH135 hi-hat + PCY135/PCY155 crashes + PCY175 ride), Preset 70 Kits, Voices 733, Bluetooth Audio, USB TO HOST + MIDI IN/OUT, HS740A hi-hat stand, and kit Weight 46.77 kg. The Yamaha products page and the Amazon listing both name the tone module "DTX-PROX" and state "TCS heads are used for snare and toms," verifying the model identity and the silicone (non-mesh) pad type. Kraft Music (retailer) corroborates the DTX-PROX module, 70 preset kits, and 733 voices, and lists the street price of $5,169.99 for the Real Wood DTX10K-X.

products.name: EFNOTE 5
products.priceNote: US street price from Guitar Center: $3,199.00 for the "EFNOTE 5 Acoustic-Designed Electronic Drum Set - White Sparkle" (Item #: 1500000433555). No separate MSRP is published on the fetched pages; the official EFNOTE page lists no price.
products.provenance: The official EFNOTE product page (ef-note.com/EFNOTE5) confirms the exact model and its Spec tab states Sound Module EFD-5, "Preset Drum Kits: 17", a 12x5" 7-sensor snare with 2-ply mesh head, 10x7"/12x12" mesh toms, a 16x12" mesh kick, and USB MIDI in/out plus Bluetooth audio-in and Bluetooth MIDI. Guitar Center's listing for the exact "EFNOTE 5 Acoustic-Designed Electronic Drum Set - White Sparkle" (Item #1500000433555) corroborates the spec sheet — 98 factory/multilayer sounds, 17 preset kits, Integrated USB audio interface (8 out/2 in), Bluetooth for audio-in and MIDI, and an included-components list of 4 drum pads (snare, tom, floor tom, kick) plus 4 cymbal pads (hi-hat, splash, crash, ride) with the hi-hat stand sold separately — and states the price of $3,199.00. Neither fetched page discloses a total kit weight, so weightKg is left null.

products.name: Simmons Titan 50
products.priceNote: Guitar Center product page lists the Simmons Titan 50 Electronic Drum Kit With Mesh Pads & Bluetooth at $399.00 (marked Sold Out at fetch time); used as typical US street price.
products.provenance: The official Simmons product page (simmonsdrums.net/dp/titan-50) confirms this exact model as a 5-piece kit with mesh heads and 3 cymbals, and states verbatim "25 Preset and 10 User Drum Kits", "187 Drum Sounds", a dual-zone 10" mesh snare, three 8" mesh toms, a 6" kick pad, 10" hi-hat/crash/ride cymbals, "Bluetooth Audio and MIDI", and "USB Audio and MIDI – Functions as a 2×2 audio interface with MIDI I/O".
